summary: Alan Wake entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Alan Wake

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows remaster with current patch features

primary.why: The remaster is the modern high-fidelity route, and the PC build has the strongest settings ceiling. The original PC version remains a comparison path only.
primary.how_to_play: Use Alan Wake Remastered on PC with current patch level; compare the original PC build only if preserving the original presentation is a specific episode goal.

entries.remaster_caveats: Alan Wake's American Nightmare is a separate game and is not included in Alan Wake Remastered.

entries.title: Alan Wake II

primary.why: Alan Wake II shipped on PS5, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S. PC has the highest graphics/settings ceiling; expansion ownership must be verified for the complete story package.
primary.how_to_play: Use the PC build with latest patch and expansions installed if the archive includes complete story content; verify graphics settings before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: Expansion ownership must be verified; do not assume a base install is the complete story package.

primary.why: The Windows release has the highest fidelity ceiling and no sourced exclusive story content is tied to Xbox 360.
primary.how_to_play: Use the PC version at native resolution; this is a separate spin-off and should be run after Alan Wake if following release order.
